mapper.sql: encode(ST_AsEWKB(ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D( CASE WHEN ST_SRID(${col}) = 0 THEN ST_SetSRID(${col}, 4326) ELSE ST_Transform(${col}, 4326) END), 3))), 'hex')
mapper.select: SELECT projectid AS project_id, AS project_no, AS project_name, CASE WHEN stage_dm ILIKE 'Detailed%Minor%' THEN 'Minor Amendment' WHEN stage_dm ILIKE 'Detailed%Time%' THEN 'Time Extension' WHEN stage_dm ILIKE 'Detailed%' THEN 'Detailed' WHEN stage_dm ILIKE 'Concept%' THEN 'Concept' WHEN stage_dm ILIKE 'Enquiry%' THEN 'Enquiry' ELSE 'Other' END AS stage, stage_dm AS stage_raw, CASE WHEN approvalyear ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN approvalyear::int END AS approval_year, AS developer_name, municipality AS src_municipality, CASE municipality WHEN 'Abu Dhabi' THEN 'ADM' WHEN 'Al Ain' THEN 'AAM' WHEN 'Western Region' THEN 'WRM' END AS municipality_code, AS src_district_id, AS src_community_id, AS masterplan_level, AS project_type, AS project_lead, AS owner_name, AS parent_project_no, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.masterplanBoundary} WHERE projectid IS NOT NULL AND shape IS NOT NULL

SELECT coalesce(objectid_1, objectid) AS src_objectid, projectid AS project_id, AS masterplan_type, AS approval_status, AS udm_gisid, AS udm_plot_number, AS registered_land_use, AS land_use_l1, AS land_use_l2, md_plot_area AS plot_area_sqm, floor_area_ratio AS far, building_storey AS building_storeys, number_of_buildings AS buildings, residential_population, total_residential_units, hotel_rooms, coalesce(total_gfa, calc_total_gfa) AS total_gfa, residential_gfa, office_gfa, retail_gfa, hotel_gfa, industrial_gfa, commercial_recreation_gfa, religious_gfa, education_gfa, healthcare_gfa, community_facilities_gfa, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.masterplanPlot}
SELECT coalesce(constructionsiteid::text, 'o' || objectid) AS site_id, AS description, AS municipality_code, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.constructionSite} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN ${col} ~ '^[0-9A-Fa-f]+$' AND length(${col}) % 2 = 0 THEN ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode(${col}, 'hex')) WHEN ${col} ~* '^\s*(SRID=[0-9]+;)?\s*(MULTI)?(POINT|LINESTRING|POLYGON)\s*\(|^\s*(SRID=[0-9]+;)?\s*GEOMETRYCOLLECTION' THEN ST_GeomFromEWKT(${col}) END
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.project_id) trim(d.project_id) AS project_id, coalesce(, ) AS project_name, AS category, AS phase, AS status, AS project_type, AS dof_no, CASE WHEN abs(d.approved_budget) < 1e15 THEN round(d.approved_budget, 2) END AS approved_budget, CASE WHEN abs(d.cumulative_expenditures) < 1e15 THEN round(d.cumulative_expenditures, 2) END AS cumulative_expenditures, d.original_planned_com_date::date AS original_planned_com_date, d.actual_forecast_com_date::date AS actual_forecast_com_date, CASE WHEN abs(d.actual_progress) < 1e6 THEN round(d.actual_progress, 2) END AS actual_progress, CASE WHEN abs(d.revised_progress) < 1e6 THEN round(d.revised_progress, 2) END AS revised_progress, CASE WHEN abs(d.original_progress) < 1e6 THEN round(d.original_progress, 2) END AS original_progress, AS cip_location_district, AS cip_location_community, AS cip_location_plot, AS src_municipality, AS municipality_code, AS contractor_name, CASE WHEN d.start_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2100 THEN d.start_year::int END AS start_year, CASE WHEN h.geo IS NOT NULL THEN g.k END AS geom_kind, encode(ST_AsEWKB(ST_Force2D(CASE WHEN h.geo IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ST_SRID(h.geo) = 0 AND abs(ST_X(ST_PointOnSurface(h.geo))) > 1000 THEN ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(h.geo, 32640), 4326) WHEN ST_SRID(h.geo) = 0 THEN ST_SetSRID(h.geo, 4326) WHEN ST_SRID(h.geo) = 4326 THEN h.geo ELSE ST_Transform(h.geo, 4326) END)), 'hex') AS geom_hex FROM ${t.gsecProjects} d LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (project_id) project_id, shape FROM ${t.gsecPoints} WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(shape), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY project_id, objectid DESC) pt ON pt.project_id = d.project_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (project_id) project_id, shape FROM ${t.gsecPolygons} WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(shape), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY project_id, objectid DESC) pg ON pg.project_id = d.project_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT trim(coalesce(pt.shape, pg.shape)) AS s, CASE WHEN pt.shape IS NOT NULL THEN 'point' WHEN pg.shape IS NOT NULL THEN 'polygon' END AS k) g CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AS geo) h WHERE nullif(trim(d.project_id), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.project_id, d.last_modified_on DESC NULLS LAST, d.objectid DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.permitnumber) trim(s.permitnumber) AS permit_number, s.permitissuingdate::date AS issuing_date, AS gisid, AS permit_status, AS project_status, s.projectcompletiondate::date AS project_completion_date, AS delayed_status, s.delayedvariance AS delayed_variance_days, AS project_number, AS project_name, AS owner_type, s.projectregistrationdate::date AS registration_date, s.projectworkstartdate::date AS work_start_date, AS expected_completion, AS land_use, AS zone, AS sector, AS plot_number, AS src_municipality, AS municipality_code, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.emecs} s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AS a, AS b) c WHERE nullif(trim(s.permitnumber), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.permitnumber, s.permitissuingdate DESC NULLS LAST, s.sno DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT AS project_number, AS project_name, AS project_type, AS project_type_name, CASE WHEN s.projecttypename ~* 'complet' THEN 'completion' WHEN s.projecttypename ~* 'demoli' THEN 'demolition' WHEN s.projecttypename ~* '(mainten|repair|renovat)' THEN 'maintenance' ELSE 'other' END AS kind, AS current_status, s.projectsubmissiondate::date AS submission_date, AS zone, AS sector, AS plot_number, AS land_use_group, AS is_legalization, s.projectkpistartdate::date AS kpi_start_date, s.projectkpienddate::date AS kpi_end_date, s.projectlaststatusupdatedate::date AS last_status_date, s.projectcompletionduration AS duration_days, AS src_municipality, AS municipality_code FROM ${t.meps} s
